note: The creator's beliefs quiz (DESIGN §4, T10). Each statement is answered from strongly disagree (-2) to strongly agree (+2). Weights say where agreeing moves you: econ -1 = left, +1 = right; social -1 = liberal, +1 = authoritarian; issues use the poles in ISSUE_LABELS (negative = the 'low' pole). Statements alternate direction so that agreeing with everything lands near the centre. Game design, not a validated survey instrument.

statements.text: The government should own the railways and the water companies.
Taxes are too high: people should keep more of what they earn.
The NHS needs more money, even if that means higher taxes.
Immigration to Britain should be cut substantially.
Britain should rejoin the European Union.
Britain should reach net zero sooner, even if it costs households more for a while.
Criminals should serve longer prison sentences.
Councils, not private developers, should build most new homes.
Defence spending should rise, even if other budgets are cut.
Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland should run more of their own affairs.
Traditional British values are under threat and should be defended.
Trade unions should have more power to protect workers.
Private companies should be allowed to run more NHS services.
People should be free to live as they choose, so long as they harm no one else.
